title: A child off to university
tagline: Tuition, a student room and a first own account, organised for the whole family.
trigger: A parent pays a university or college tuition fee.

steps.title: The study budget
steps.description: Tuition, rent for a student room, books and living costs, from what you already pay.
steps.why: Based on your own payments; nothing is shared.
steps.result: Study budget ready: €{tuition} tuition paid; plan for roughly €{study_monthly} a month for a room and living costs (illustrative).

steps.title: An account and card for the student
steps.description: A youth account and debit card, with a monthly allowance you can schedule.
steps.why: Opened in the app; you can follow it while they learn to manage money.
steps.result: Student account opened with a monthly allowance.

steps.title: Insured on the student room
steps.description: Check that your family insurance also covers a child living away from home.
steps.why: Family liability insurance often covers students in a room; we check yours.
steps.result: Family insurance checked for the student room.

steps.title: Spread the costs
steps.description: A savings plan for the years ahead, or a study loan if needed.
steps.why: Only if it helps; most families need neither.
steps.result: Savings plan for next year's tuition started.
